summary.prose: Building this correction is three small, independent edits: a shared path-derivation helper in the daemon's workflow module so the new openable scanner can't drift from the existing pending scanner's safety checks; a client-side mirror method in the VS Code extension so its own auto-open logic reads the same openable list the MCP tool already reads; and a one-paragraph wording fix to a tool description. None of the three depend on each other, and none change any existing method's behavior.

tasks.title: Extract mdPathForKind and wire toDescriptor + resolveOpenableArtifacts to it
tasks.summary: Add mdPathForKind(repoPath, kind, artifactId, meta) to src/workflow/pending.ts, extracting toDescriptor's existing BUILD (buildRecordMdPath existence+marker check) and AMD (always '') path rules verbatim. Change toDescriptor's inline ternary and resolveOpenableArtifacts' direct deriveMdPath call to both call the new helper instead.

mdPathForKind returns '' for every AMD record, unconditionally

resolveOpenableArtifacts returns '' for an AMD record (regression test for the reviewer's fabricated-AMD.md-path finding)

tasks.title: Add openableDocuments() to DocsReviewClient and wire the VS Code auto-open path to it
tasks.summary: Add openableDocuments() to vscode-plugin/src/chat/docs-review-client.ts, mirroring pendingDocuments()'s shape but calling workflow.openable. Change vscode-plugin/src/extension.ts:732's reviewPresenter pendingDocuments dependency to call reviewClient.openableDocuments() instead of reviewClient.pendingDocuments(). Update docs-review-client.test.ts's source-scan completeness test (t2: source-scan, lines 277-288) to include 'workflow.openable' in its expected method list -- it currently hard-fails on any new daemon-method string literal in the file.
acceptanceChecks: DocsReviewClient.openableDocuments calls the daemon's 'workflow.openable' method, not 'workflow.pending'
review-presenter declared() opens a document that is approved/rejected/has no CR sibling when its source list is openable-shaped, where the old pending-only fixture would have refused it
docs-review-client.test.ts's source-scan completeness test passes with 'workflow.openable' added to its expected method list
pendingDocuments() and workflow.pending are untouched -- the JetBrains review panel's narrower semantics keep working
